turns.responseText:
IVIVE Hepatic Clearance (Well-Stirred Model) — Scales measured microsomal CLint to predicted human hepatic clearance and extraction ratio for 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs using the well-stirred liver model.

Input: 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs — Dasatinib (CLint=220, fu_plasma=0.04), Bosutinib (CLint=60, fu_plasma=0.03), Imatinib (CLint=25, fu_plasma=0.04), Nilotinib (CLint=12, fu_plasma=0.01); Qh=20.7 mL/min/kg, fu_mic=1.0
Key steps:

PKNCA/well-stirred model → scales CLint_microsomal (μL/min/mg) × fu_mic → CLint_scaled (mL/min/kg) per compound
Well-stirred equation: CLh = Qh × (fu_plasma × CLint_scaled) / (Qh + fu_plasma × CLint_scaled) → predicted CLh + extraction ratio (E = CLh / Qh) per TKI


Expected output: ivive_results.csv (CLh mL/min/kg + extraction ratio E per compound) + clearance_summary.json (model parameters, scaled CLint, inter-compound comparison)

Decision gate: Flag compounds with E > 0.7 as high-extraction (flow-limited, high first-pass risk — oral bioavailability likely low) and E < 0.3 as low-extraction (capacity-limited, systemic exposure expected — protein binding changes will drive DDI risk for Nilotinib and Bosutinib).

Pocket Detection & Druggability Assessment — BCR-ABL1 (1IEP) — Identifies and ranks all binding pockets on the BCR-ABL1 DFG-out kinase structure using fpocket, with focus on the imatinib allosteric site.


Input: PDB ID 1IEP (BCR-ABL1 kinase, DFG-out conformation)


Key steps:

fpocket → detects all surface pockets, computes druggability scores, volume, hydrophobicity, and alpha-sphere density per pocket
Pocket ranker → sorts top 10 pockets by druggability score + volume, flags the DFG-out allosteric cavity consistent with imatinib binding geometry



Expected output: pocket_summary.csv (top 10 pockets ranked by druggability score + volume) · druggability_scores.json (per-pocket physicochemical descriptors) · ranked HTML report with 3D pocket visualization


Decision gate: Imatinib-compatible pocket must score druggability ≥ 0.5 and volume ≥ 500 ų — pockets below either threshold are deprioritized for structure-based drug design follow-up.

turns.responseText:
ABL1 Pharmacophore Model + Library Screening — Builds a consensus pharmacophore from 4 known ABL1 inhibitors and screens a compound library to identify feature-matched hits.

Input: Reference SMILES — Imatinib, Dasatinib, Bosutinib, Asciminib (4 ABL1 inhibitors); Library SMILES — Gleevec-analog-1, Ponatinib, Terfenadine, Acetaminophen; min_features = 3
Key steps:

Pharmacophore tool → derives consensus 3D pharmacophore model (H-bond donors/acceptors, hydrophobic centers, aromatic rings, charged groups) from the 4 reference inhibitors
Pharmacophore Alignment tool → aligns each library compound against the model, scores feature overlap, and flags hits meeting ≥ 3 matched features


Expected output: Filtered hits list with per-compound pharmacophore match scores, feature-overlap summary table, and ranked SDF/CSV of library compounds (expect Gleevec-analog-1 and Ponatinib to score high; Acetaminophen likely filtered out as a non-hit)

Decision gate: Retain only compounds matching ≥ 3 pharmacophore features with an alignment score above the model threshold — these advance to docking (AutoDock Vina / Glide) for binding pose validation against the ABL1 kinase domain (PDB: 1IEP).

turns.responseText:
BCR-ABL1 Campaign Safety-Potency Ranking — Ingests dual-assay IC50 data for 15 compounds and produces a composite potency-safety rank with hERG cardiac flagging.

Input: 30-row assay CSV (15 compounds × 2 assay types: IC50_BCR_ABL1 in nM + hERG_IC50 in µM, dated 2026-03-15)
Key steps:

CSV parser → pivots long-format assay rows into per-compound potency + safety columns, normalises units (nM → µM)
Composite scorer → log-transforms IC50 values, applies weighted rank (BCR-ABL1 potency 60% / hERG safety 40%), flags compounds with hERG IC50 < 1 µM as cardiac risk (CPD003, CPD005, CPD009, CPD010, CPD014)
Report generator → ranked_compounds.csv + HTML league table + JSON summary with selectivity index (hERG IC50 / BCR-ABL1 IC50) per compound


Expected output: ranked_compounds.csv (rank, composite score, potency score, safety flag), ranking_report.html (interactive table with red/amber/green traffic-light safety tiers), campaign_summary.json (top hits, flagged compounds, selectivity indices)

Decision gate: hERG IC50 < 1 µM → automatic cardiac risk flag (disqualifies CPD009 [0.08 µM] and CPD010 [0.05 µM] to bottom tier regardless of BCR-ABL1 potency); BCR-ABL1 IC50 < 1 nM + hERG IC50 > 10 µM → Tier 1 advancement (expected: CPD005 [0.37 nM / 0.9 µM amber], CPD006 [0.5 nM / 30 µM green], CPD004 [1 nM / 30 µM green]).
